name: Milk
description: Standardized cow milk, 3.5% fat, used as the primary base for ice cream mix.

name: Cream
description: Dairy cream, 40% fat, used to raise fat content of the mix.

name: Sugar
description: Refined cane sugar used for sweetening the mix.

name: Stabilizer & Emulsifier Blend
description: Guar gum / mono-diglyceride blend used to control ice crystal growth and improve texture.

name: Flavour & Colour Concentrate
description: Food-grade flavour and colour concentrate dosed at the flavouring station.
